contrasts: EST-L and EST-Q on original comparison groups
analysis.exclusion_lock: No post-group task/team removal for failure, abandonment, low tool use or incomplete work
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Report all effects and limits; do not infer quality preservation from nonsignificance
analysis.missing_data: No primary complete-case redefinition. An unresolved team endpoint returns a full parameter-domain confidence set and no rejection/benefit; report available physical/observation bounds separately.

diagnostics: Per-outcome coverage calibration across supported nuisance ranges
models.model_or_procedure: Mean of within-pair AI-minus-comparator outcomes; Student-t standard error over pairs; expand by declared measurement-bias allowance
outputs: Joint success and each component decision

analysis.multiplicity: A false conjunction entails rejection of a true component null. Conditional on valid level.025 component procedures, the conjunction has level.025; the approximate t components have separately measured calibration under declared scenarios, not universal exact size.
analysis.preprocessing_lock: Record hashes of initial task/score/group manifests and collection/scoring/analysis versions before outcomes
analysis.severe_defects: Record and report separately. Statistical joint success concerns labour and retained required output only; it establishes no overall safety/adoption benefit. Severe-defect incidence is not simulated and is not silently included in planning power.
analysis.stopping_rule: No interim efficacy decision; finish all28day windows before final analysis
analysis.uncertainty: One-sided97.5% t bounds expanded by measurement-bias allowances. Reported coverage is for these sensitivity-expanded intervals; raw t coverage and exact finite-sample guarantees are not claimed.

assumptions.statement: No material effects transmitted between comparison clusters

interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Toolset manifest must record provider/model/build, prompts, context, repository read/edit/test permissions, maximum concurrent processes, resource budgets, review and release rules before pilot
manipulation_checks: Tool access/version logs and actual-use record
off_target_checks: Review, concurrency, resource pressure and cross-group code/person sharing
recovery_checks: No crossover; record version changes as deviations, not replacement without amendment
interventions_or_exposures.target: Whole development workflow, including prompting, review and repair
interventions_or_exposures.timing: No group switching; provide access after initial tasks and scores recorded; follow each task for28days

measurements.blinding: Outcome reviewers concealed from comparison labels where possible; record failures
measurements.calibration: Known scripted-duration, overlap, missing-contributor and off-keyboard cases; account for residual reference uncertainty
measurements.error_model: Mean-zero cluster measurement variation in planning plus provisional difference-bias allowance 0.2 hours/reference unit; empirical justification absent
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Contemporaneous ledger plus contributing-person list, capacity checks and separately collected validation evidence
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same collection and scoring procedures across groups; pilot must assess differential error
measurements.observable: Participant-recorded allocations by person, task and type of work in a complete 15-minute ledger
measurements.preprocessing: Initial reference score is one unit per recorded requirement-task for this concrete plan. Every person interval appears once across tasks/teams. Use a prospective attribution rule for shared review/platform time, never double-count; retain ambiguous allocation as bounds or unresolved records, not exact imputed totals. Sampling estimates are not deterministic interval totals.
measurements.reactivity: Recording and reviewer feedback may alter work; log feedback and count attributable repair within window
measurements.reliability: Duplicate selected person-days and report disagreement without treating it as accuracy
measurements.timing: Ledger throughout672hours for every initial task; no selection by first acceptance or eventual completion
measurements.validity: True-labour interpretation conditional on contributor coverage, shared-work attribution and supported differential-bias evidence; ambiguous/missing endpoints block affirmative claim under this version.

excluded_conclusions: No organisation-wide adoption effect on incoming work
No effect of actual minutes of AI use
method_selection.inference_framework: Finite participating-team potential outcomes; unbiased paired mean estimate with empirically assessed t approximation

question: Does providing a specified AI toolset and working practices reduce all included person-hours per initial reference unit while preserving retained required output?

reproducibility.code_plan: Version and pin analysis before trial; planning.py/results retained here
reproducibility.data_plan: Keep raw allocations and requirement checks, failed/missing records and provenance; no public release of sensitive work records assumed
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: Preserve original plan and time-stamped deviations; changes before confirmatory outcomes only with explicit new revision
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Record provider/model/tool/scoring and collector versions, timestamps and amendments
reproducibility.randomisation_or_seed_plan: Study group coins generated by independent analyst after manifests recorded; reveal seed after group records fixed. Planning seed20261101 is separate.
reproducibility.registration: Register final confirmed protocol before principal outcomes; no registration performed

sampling.attrition_or_loss: No affirmative claim if any team primary endpoint remains missing; all units retained in reporting
sampling.dependence_structure: Independent pair coin flips; arbitrary within-team task dependence; no inflation of independent count by tasks/intervals
inputs: Provisional thresholds and scenarios in planning.py
sampling.method: Institutional teams selected before group choice; fair within-pair coins; all initial tasks retained
sampling.minimum_detectable_effect: Not estimated. Planning effect -2 hours/referenceunit differs from meaningful decision boundary -1; no effect-size substitution is made.
sampling.multiplicity: Joint benefit requires both component conditions; secondary analyses descriptive
sampling.pilot_coverage: Two pairs in each of three predeclared repository/work types within intended principal population; bounded procedural rehearsal, not precise variance or rare-loss estimation
sampling.result: Neither principal candidate meets specified joint-success target over required hypothetical scenarios
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Central/adverse matching and variation, each partial null with and without maximal favourable allowed bias, joint boundary, harm, beyond-bound bias failure and missing endpoints; no guarantee over arbitrary distributions
sampling.stopping_implications: Fixed sample and complete28day follow-up; no efficacy peeking or optional extension

scope.conditions: Parallel AI-access versus no-generative-AI groups, exact delivery manifest required before pilot
exclusions: No organisation-wide adoption effect on incoming work
No effect of actual minutes of AI use
scope.spatial_scope: Current design randomises one team/repository per cluster, with no material cross-cluster transmission; changed cluster definitions require a new estimator/planning revision preserving equal-team weighting
scope.system_or_population: Participating software teams with independently tracked initial requirement sets; no population-wide transport claim
scope.temporal_scope: Pilot and separate principal study: tau=Delta=336hours (14calendar days each); labour followup672hours (28days)

skill_application.fallback: validate_protocol.py bounded local record/reference/numeric checker; no bundled validation claim
